title: Check Adjacent Digit Differences
summary: Given a string s consisting of digits, return true if the absolute difference between every pair of adjacent digits is at most 2, otherwise return false.
statement: Given a string s consisting of digits, return true if the absolute difference between every pair of adjacent digits is at most 2, otherwise return false. The absolute difference between two digits a and b is defined as |a - b| .
constraints: s contains at least two decimal digits.
Every neighboring digit pair must differ by at most two.
Return whether all pairs meet the inclusive bound.
reference_solution:
def adjacent_digit_differences_at_most_two(s):
    return all(abs(int(s[i])-int(s[i+1]))<=2 for i in range(len(s)-1))
hints: Convert both digit characters to integers.
Reject a difference greater than two.
All pairs must pass, including the final pair.
editorial: All pairs must pass, including the final pair.

tests.explanation: The differences are two and one, both within the limit.
The final difference is seven, so the condition fails.
